title: O Mankind, Don’t be Troublemakers!
body:
Suhbah after Salaat al-Jumu`ah
As-salaamu `alaykum. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah. Allahu
Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! Allahuma salli `alaa Sayyidina Muhammad, Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa
’l-akhireen wa `alaa alihi wa sahbihi ajma`een. As-salaatu wa-salaam `alaa jami` al-anbiyaa wal-mursaleen
wa man tabi`ahum bi ihsaan ila Yawmi’d-Deen. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
O People! As-salaamu `alaykum. Madad, yaa Sultan al-Awliya. Madad, yaa RijaalAllah. Amidoon bi
madadikum. O People! Greetings to believers from heavenly people, for the honor of the Seal of Prophets,
Sayyidina Muhammad (s). (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) Allah Almighty has greeted him and his nation,
particularly in this holy month and heavenly ones are also greeting the Seal of Prophets’ nation. If (anyone is)
not accepting him as the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-`Akhireen, Allah Almighty is never
granting them to be prophets and every honored one in Creation is taking honor from his honor.
O People! We are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
This is a seating here in an unknown point on Earth and He, Allah Almighty, may do anything as He likes. We

can't reach a level to ask from Him directly; we are asking through His Only Representive (s), who is the
crown prince. The Heavenly Kingdom is only for the Lord of Heavens (...) and the Seal of Prophets (s) is only
one; there can't be two or three or more, no! He is only one in the known territories of the Lord of Heavens!
When He is creating, the crown prince is knowing and (ascending in) the Night of Journey!
O People! We are speaking from spiritual points that we must believe, and we must try to make our belief
more broad. In the Night of Journey, Laylat al-Mi`raaj, where the Seal of Prophets (s) reached, including that
huge territory to where his power never reached, he, our crown prince, looked and saw himself! Allahu
Akbar! (...) and they were running as a huge river.
He asked, "O Jibreel! Who are they?"
And he said, "O, Seal of Prophets! I have seen them, but since I was created running in such a way, I don't
know the beginning or ending." A small spot in space that no one knows from where it is coming to where it
is going. Allahu Akbar!
O People! We are ignorant. Mostly our lives never have any value.
O People! Try to stop troubles on Earth. What is the Lord's heavenly order for all of Mankind? I ask the
Muslim world's `ulama, and rabbis, the Pope and all religious people the one question: what is the Lord's
order for Mankind? “O My Creatures! Keep My orders and keep away from My forbidden things." That was
the command from Allah to our people on this planet? It was, "O Human Beings! Try to be My servants, and
say that I am the Creator Who created you! I am your Lord! Say this!"
First of all we must say, “O our Lord! We are Your servants!” That is the command for all of Mankind, "Be My
servants and keep My oath that you will only be servants for Me." And what was the Lord of Heavens
preventing? It was only one, also. The Lord of Heavens said, "O My servants! Take care, pay attention and
keep it.” It is so easy and so short: “O My servants! First, say that I am your Lord and you are My servants,
and second, that I am prohibiting (what is bad for you).”
Think on it. The Lord of Heavens said, "O My servants! Don't be troublemakers!" One word for all nations,
"Don't be troublemakers!" Pttu on those nations whose citizens are troublemakers! What that person is

advising us I am not advising you. The Lord of Heavens is saying to the Seal of Prophets (s) and from his
ocean, one small drop I am keeping, sending to advise all nations, "O People! O My Servants! I command
you, don't be troublemakers!”
Shaytan says, "Don't listen; always be troublemakers to reach something from this life's treasures and
imitated titles." Shaytan is saying this and the Lord of Heavens is ordering, "Don't be troublemakers." Did
Moammar Ghaddafi listen to his Lord, Allah Almighty, or was he a troublemaker? Turkey, Egypt, Iran,
Baghdad, and Afghanistan are the same, all troublemakers. No one among them is saying, "O People! We
must keep holy orders and not be troublemakers!"
This is a very short advice, finished! Anyone who urges you to be troublemakers, kick them and take them
away and don't leave them to be among you! Therefore, the Lord of Heavens said in His holy book, which is
the last revealed holy book, said, "O My servants! Don’t be troublemakers! If you listen to Shaytan and obey
him, you will disobey Me. Then I will send you to the the center of troubles and fire, taking you away to a hole
of fire or to a black hole, finished!” Allah Almighty created them and will take them away from existence!
Perhaps countless people that were not obeying their Creator by keeping His holy commands, who did
everything against their Lord's orders, will be taken that way.
"O My creatures! Don't be troublemakers, but be good ones, as I keep good ones and bad ones I am throwing
out and they disappear. However, you may do as you like: make a way for troublemakers’ schools, centers and
academies; go there and I will bring you to a black hole, inside of which you will disappear!”
O Our Governors, Presidents and Leaders! Think on this short advice. If you are not listening and obeying,
Allah Almighty has the power to send unseen armies to take you away.
O Mankind! Keep yourselves (clean) and leave being troublemakers, but be loyal and obedient to the Lord
and keep your mercy for everything, even they may make me speak up to next week, next Ramadan, or up to
the end of the world never finishing, but we are weak servants and I am a now a weak servant. I don't know if
it is going to be my last Ramadan or more, only He knows.
May Allah grant you a strong a faith, to believe and follow orders, and to know they are holy orders; if not,
you will be punished in a way that will make you unable, perhaps by cutting your head, hands, body, or

burning your body! May Allah forgive us and grant us, for the honor of His most beloved servant, Sayyidina
Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
I am weak and I am hungry, also. Therefore, I am tired, but as they are granting to me, I am speaking to you.
May Allah forgive me, forgive you and grant you what He dressed His good servants, to be eternal ones in His
Divine Presence, for the honor of the most honored one here and Hereafter, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)!
(Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
Fatihah.
(Baya`)
